implementation.name: A-Z80
implementation.notes: License: GPL-2.0-only. https://github.com/gdevic/A-Z80/blob/master/license.txt is the verbatim GPLv2 text and https://github.com/gdevic/A-Z80/blob/master/readme.txt states "This project and each file therein is covered under the GNU GPL2.0 license" with no "or later" option, so GPL-2.0-only rather than -or-later. hdl_language_id is mixed: hand-written SystemVerilog testbenches alongside Quartus-generated Verilog from .bdf schematics. No single is_top path is marked because the top level is assembled by the repo's export.py script rather than being one checked-in file. accuracy_id omitted: the readme calls it "A conceptual implementation of the Z80 CPU" and makes no timing claim.
